newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-MIHAJLOVIC OUT OF ACTION FOR A MONTH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MIHAJLOVIC OUT OF ACTION FOR A MONTH.

text.p: Sampdoria's Yugoslav defender Sinisa Mihajlovic, who recently had a four-match disciplinary ban halved, heard on Friday he would be sidelined for the next month anyway due to a thigh injury.
Mihajlovic picked up the injury during a World Cup qualifier against the Czech Republic on Wednesday.
Sampdoria officials said the injury was more serious than first thought and the Yugoslav was likely to be out until the club's match against Juventus in Turin on May 4.

Mihajlovic was handed a four-match ban after being sent off in a league match for kicking a ball at a referee after a penalty was awarded against his Genoa club. It was reduced to two matches on appeal.
